findings.statement: The original compact history model slightly improves a residual kernel on average, but misses a simpler lag-two control.
findings.applicability: Complete PING runs with successful-response targets; five completed prior probes and causal radio data, not target sequence/timestamp/parity.
findings.limitations: The compact model loses 2/3 runs against kernel; one lost probe has no RTT and remains missing. A 1.68 %mean gain does not identify scheduler/queue physics.
falsification: Include lag-two persistence with identical information access.
Keep missing lost-probe RTTs unscored but assigned, and never use lost flags or current response timestamps as predictors.
Treat 50 msdecision thresholds as illustrative unless a service requirement is independently documented.
findings.prior_art: Persistence/filtering families are known; an omitted-comparator correction is valuable methodological evidence, not new communications physics. This review uses retained prior-art records only; it performs no new literature priority adjudication.
